other formal:
datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"
abbreviation bst :: "('a::linorder) tree ⇒ bool" where "bst ≡ bst_wrt (<)"

formal function definitions.bst_wrt:
fun bst_wrt :: "('a ⇒ 'a ⇒ bool) ⇒ 'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "bst_wrt P Leaf ⟷ True" |
  "bst_wrt P (Node (l) (a) (r)) ⟷ (∀x∈set_tree l. P x a) ∧ (∀x∈set_tree r. P a x) ∧ bst_wrt P l ∧ bst_wrt P r"
formal function definitions.set_tree:
fun set_tree :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a set" where
  "set_tree Leaf = {}" |
  "set_tree (Node l a r) = {a} ∪ set_tree l ∪ set_tree r"
